title: Handwriting (Theme 2: Activities in the home)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the tall letters and checks that each reaches the top line.
contexts: activities in the home: kitchen, table

board.do: Point at the part to look at.
Wait for the child to answer.
The child writes or fixes it.
Show the right version beside it.

misconceptions.ask: Does it touch the top line?

listen_for: Bed (in the middle of a sentence)
t as tall as l, crossed at the top
misconceptions.ask: Is t as tall as l?

checks.question: Which letter is tall: o, d, m?
Which "kite" is right?
checks.answer: k and t taller than i and e
